channel.title: @godotengine.org - Godot Engine

item.description:
#GodotEngine will support spatial containers in the upcoming 4.8 release and we are excited to see how developers use these new engine's capabilities.
Spatial Containers bring new capabilities to XR applications to work in shared spatial environments.
Read more: https://www.khronos.org/blog/openxr-spatial-containers

The 4.8 release cycle reaches an ever-important milestone with its very first beta snapshot: #GodotEngine 4.8 beta 1 arrives! 🎉
We've prepared a feature-packed blog post showcasing the main highlights for this new version:
https://godotengine.org/article/dev-snapshot-godot-4-8-beta-1/

With over 400 entries submitted for the Godot Showreel 2026, it's time to vote. As a Development Fund member, you can help us choose the best of the best.
Join the Fund fund.godotengine.org and cast your votes!
🗳️ Open until the 18th of October: showreel.godotengine.org https://showreel.godotengine.org

Build issues have been officially resolved; downloads are once again functioning as expected! 🥳
[contains quote post or other embedded content]

There was an issue with the builds, so this is a great chance to learn how to compile Godot :)
https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/engine_details/development/compiling/index.html
Sorry for the trouble, and thank you everyone for participating in the dev builds, it really helps us out iron out the releases (when you get to try them, that is)
[contains quote post or other embedded content]

Our final 4.8 development snapshot has arrived with #GodotEngine 4.8 dev 7!
Symbol renaming, runtime CanvasItem manipulation, animated decals, non-allocating physics queries, UI audio events, AccessKit for iOS and Android, and more are ready for testing:
https://godotengine.org/article/dev-snapshot-godot-4-8-dev-7/

📣 LAST CALL
[contains quote post or other embedded content]

"Another development snapshot already? Didn't they just release one last Friday?"
Indeed, this is primarily a hotfix release for macOS and the Google Play store. Despite that, #GodotEngine 4.8 dev 6 still has a fair amount to show off!
https://godotengine.org/article/dev-snapshot-godot-4-8-dev-6/

From the outside, rendering optimization can look a little bit like black magic. That's why @clayjohn.bsky.social, lead maintainer of the rendering team, is here to show a few examples of some optimizations from this year to highlight that optimizing rendering code isn’t as scary as it sounds. https://godotengine.org/article/rendering-cpu-optimizations/

A stream of new features are flowing your way! 🚣
Mip-level texture streaming, preserving alpha test coverage, a reworked toolbar for the 2D editor, and more await in #GodotEngine 4.8 dev 5
https://godotengine.org/article/dev-snapshot-godot-4-8-dev-5/

Development of Godot 4.8 is firing on all cylinders! 🏎️
#GodotEngine 4.8 dev 4 brings Trail3D, VisualShader node groups, main screen dock support, multi-bounce ambient occlusion approximation, directional lightmap specular light… Too many features to count!
https://godotengine.org/article/dev-snapshot-godot-4-8-dev-4/

At long last, a performance issue with high polling rate mice on Windows has been fixed, starting with the recently released #GodotEngine 4.7.2!
We've prepared a deeper dive as to how such a change came about & why tackling it was so important:
https://godotengine.org/article/fixing-high-polling-rate-mice-on-windows/

Godot 3.6.2 has been our recommended stable LTS version of 3.x for a while now. However, due to changes in Android and iOS, the time has come for a new build. 📱
#GodotEngine 3.6.3 has arrived, being a safe and recommended upgrade for all 3.6.x users!
https://godotengine.org/article/maintenance-release-godot-3-6-3/

Has it already been a whole month since the last 4.7 maintenance release? How time flies… 🕰️
Well, no time to dwell on the past; let's instead dwell on the past with yet another maintenance release: #GodotEngine 4.7.2!
https://godotengine.org/article/maintenance-release-godot-4-7-2/

The results are out, and for the first time, you can download all the responses as a .csv file if you want to dig deeper into the data.
Thank you everyone for participating!
https://godotengine.org/article/godot-community-poll-2026/
[contains quote post or other embedded content]

📣 Submissions open for the Godot 2026 showreel
Like last year, if you are a member of the Development Fund, you will be able to cast your votes alongside the Godot maintainers!
📅 Submissions close: October 1st 📅 Voting from October 2nd until October 16th
https://godotengine.org/article/submissions-open-godot-2026-showreel/

GodotFest is coming back to Munich on November 3 & 4.
Expect two days of talks, panels, games, and plenty of time to meet the people building with Godot Engine.
The full announcement: https://godotengine.org/article/godotfest-2026

✅ TIP: Reading development snapshot articles builds character!
Documentation admonitions, underlined warnings/errors in GDScript, FileSystem quality-of-life, and more await in #GodotEngine 4.8 dev 3:
https://godotengine.org/article/dev-snapshot-godot-4-8-dev-3/

What happens when you stabilize stability? Let's find out! 🏗️
Featuring crucial fixes for threading, mbedTLS, high poll rates for mice on Windows, and more; our first release candidate for #GodotEngine 4.7.2 is now live:
https://godotengine.org/article/release-candidate-godot-4-7-2-rc-1/

The 2026 Godot Community Poll is here: Takes about ten minutes to complete, and it's one of the more direct ways to influence where things head next. We want to hear from you! 📝
https://godotengine.org/article/godot-community-poll-2026/

While a bunch of nerds enjoy GodotCon Boston, a bunch MORE nerds can enjoy our latest development snapshot 🤓
Editor QOL improvements, VCS usability, and more await in #GodotEngine 4.8 dev 2!
https://godotengine.org/article/dev-snapshot-godot-4-8-dev-2/

The 2026 Godot Community Poll is here: Takes about ten minutes to complete, and it's one of the more direct ways to influence where things head next. We want to hear from you! 📝
https://godotengine.org/article/godot-community-poll-2026/

Hotfixes! Hotfixes! Get 'em while they're reheated! 🔥
Our first 4.7 maintenance release, #GodotEngine 4.7.1, features several regression fixes to ensure a safe and seamless foundation for developers!
https://godotengine.org/article/maintenance-release-godot-4-7-1/

Our second GodotCon in North America is right around the corner! The schedule has been announced so we thought it would be worth highlighting some of the official updates and talks that will take place during the event: https://godotengine.org/article/godotcon-us-2026-update/

Hotfixes! Hotfixes! Get 'em while they're relatively warm! 🔥
Our second maintenance release for #GodotEngine 4.7.1 arrives, with even more regression fixes at the ready:
https://godotengine.org/article/release-candidate-godot-4-7-1-rc-2/

DeNA just joined the development fund as a Corporate Gold sponsor to support .NET for mobile. Thank you for backing open-source game development.
fund.godotengine.org

Our first development snapshot for #GodotEngine 4.8 has arrived!
Docked game view enhancements, pseudolocalization previews, sticky tree items, fuzzy searching, and more await for early testing and feedback:
https://godotengine.org/article/dev-snapshot-godot-4-8-dev-1/

Hotfixes! Hotfixes! Get 'em while they're hot! 🔥
#GodotEngine 4.7's release just over a week ago has been very exciting, and we're eager to keep the ball rolling with our first 4.7.1 release candidate:
https://godotengine.org/article/release-candidate-godot-4-7-1-rc-1/

For years we have been overwhelmed by the volume of code contributions we have to review, especially from new contributors.
AI has made the problem much worse.
That's why we are taking steps to reduce the burden on maintainers while still welcoming new contributors: https://godotengine.org/article/contribution-policy-2026/

We've published Godot Engine's first written vision statement, formalizing a decade of shared experience building, releasing, and maintaining it.
This is intended to guide the Godot Foundation as we make decisions about where to allocate our resources. Read more: https://godotengine.org/article/godot-vision-statement-2026/
